intro: The questlines that change what you can get or which ending you can reach. Steps are in order; red lines are the points you can lose for this playthrough. The full wiki text for each NPC is behind the Full questline button.

npcs.reward: The Usurpation of Fire ending; Yuria's shop
steps: Agree to serve [[Yoel of Londor]] at the crumbled bridge near the start of [[Undead Settlement]]; he moves to [[Firelink Shrine]].

steps.t: Choose Draw Out True Strength with Yoel: a free level and a Dark Sigil. Each death now raises your Hollowing. At 2, 6, 12 and 15 Hollowing he offers it again, up to 5 sigils.

steps: Talk to [[Anri of Astora]] and [[Horace the Hushed]] near Halfway Fortress in [[Road of Sacrifices]] until they repeat themselves.
Beat [[Deacons of the Deep]] and talk to Anri at the shrine until they say they are going to [[Irithyll of the Boreal Valley]].
With all 5 sigils, enter [[Catacombs of Carthus]]. Yoel dies and [[Yuria of Londor]] takes his place at the shrine.
Find Anri near the giant rolling ball and answer No when they ask about Horace.
Talk to Anri at the Church of Yorshka bonfire in Irithyll until you get the Quiet resolve gesture.
Beat [[Pontiff Sulyvahn]], then talk to Yuria until she says Anri waits in the Darkmoon Tomb.
Go to the Darkmoon Tomb before the elevator to [[Anor Londo]], take the [[Sword of Avowal]] from the pilgrim and use the action button on Anri's mat.
missable: Get all 5 sigils before the Catacombs of Carthus banner appears: entering the Catacombs kills Yoel. Beating the [[Abyss Watchers]] and using their bonfire is still safe.
Do not kill the [[Old Woman of Londor]] in the Church of Yorshka: that ends Yuria's quest.
Do not heal your Dark Sigils with the [[Fire Keeper]]: that fails the quest.

npcs.reward: Siegward helps against Yhorm (if freed before you first enter the arena); Siegbräu, Catarina armor
steps: Ride the two-stage elevator in the [[Undead Settlement]] church and talk to Siegward.
Jump off the elevator halfway onto the hidden platform where Siegward sits on a ledge.
Kill the Demon below together with Siegward for a Siegbräu and the Toast gesture.
After meeting [[Unbreakable Patches]] in [[Cathedral of the Deep]], find Siegward stuck in a well outside the Cleansing Chapel bonfire. Get his armor back from Patches (buy it or kill him).
Find him in the kitchen near the Distant Manor bonfire in [[Irithyll of the Boreal Valley]], past the Sewer Centipedes.
Get the [[Old Cell Key]] in [[Irithyll Dungeon]], then reach his cell from [[Profaned Capital]]: drop from the roof near the Court Sorcerer. Open the cell and talk to him.
missable: To have Siegward join the [[Yhorm the Giant]] fight with a [[Storm Ruler]], free him before you first enter Yhorm's boss arena.
Free and talk to Siegward before you beat [[Yhorm the Giant]]. Otherwise you only get the [[Storm Ruler]]: no armor, shield or Siegbräu.
If you unlock his cell but do not talk to him, he stays there and does not join the Yhorm fight.

npcs.reward: Silvercat Ring, Sunset Shield and armor, Sirris summon for later bosses
steps: Light the Halfway Fortress bonfire; Sirris appears at the shrine briefly.
Give the [[Dreamchaser's Ashes]] to the [[Shrine Handmaid]]. Sirris comes back, teaches Darkmoon Loyalty and leaves her sign for the Deacons and the Abyss Watchers.
In Irithyll light the Central Irithyll bonfire, reload, and use her sign at the start of the bridge to help her against Creighton. She thanks you with the [[Silvercat Ring]].
After [[Curse-rotted Greatwood]] and [[Aldrich, Devourer of Gods]] are dead, buy the special [[Budding Green Blossom]] from the Handmaid.
Go back to the Greatwood arena in [[Undead Settlement]] and use her sign at the edge of the pit to help her against [[Holy Knight Hodrick]].
Accept her vow of knighthood at the shrine. You can then summon her for [[Dragonslayer Armour]] and the Twin Princes.
missable: Offering a [[Pale Tongue]] to [[Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth]] fails Sirris's quest. Finish Sirris first, then Leonhard's quest.

steps: Ride the metal cage on the back of the friendly Hollow Manservant at the top of the highest cliff in [[Undead Settlement]] to reach him.
missable: Visit him before you fight [[Curse-rotted Greatwood]]: the floor above the Pit of Hollows breaks during the fight and kills him.

npcs.reward: Blue Tearstone Ring and a shop that grows
steps: Open his cell below the Tower on the Wall bonfire in [[High Wall of Lothric]] with the Cell Key.
Find [[Loretta's Bone]] on the body hanging from the balcony of the first three-story building in [[Undead Settlement]]; hit it down and give it to him. You keep the [[Blue Tearstone Ring]].
Reload the area twice (he grieves, then gives the Curl up gesture).
Let him go pillaging. He comes back after you beat any area boss and sells new items.
missable: For the Irithyll trip, [[Unbreakable Patches]] must already be at the shrine: he goes to rescue Greirat, and you must reload and beat an area boss for both to return.
Never send him to [[Lothric Castle]]: there is no way to save him.

npcs.reward: Sorceries, Young Dragon Ring, Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring
steps: Find him on the second floor of the ruins where [[Crystal Sage]] is fought, in Crucifixion Woods.
Have 10 Intelligence (the [[Scholar Ring]] counts) and ask to learn sorceries; he moves to the shrine.
Give him at least one sorcery scroll.
Learn any four sorceries for the [[Young Dragon Ring]] (not given if you started as a [[Sorcerer]]).
Learn Aural Decoy, Farron Flashsword, Spook and Pestilent Mist for the Silent Ally gesture and the [[Slumbering Dragoncrest Ring]].
missable: Bring him a sorcery scroll before you defeat four bosses, or he leaves for this playthrough.

steps: Buy the [[Grave Key]] from the Handmaid after giving her the [[Mortician's Ashes]].
Reach Irina's cell in [[Undead Settlement]] through the sewers and open the second door with the key.
Accept her service; she moves to the east-wing basement of the shrine and sells miracles.
Talk to her at least once to get [[Eygon of Carim]]'s summon sign before the [[Crystal Sage]].
missable: Buying even one dark miracle from her makes Eygon take her to the Iudex Gundyr bonfire, where he turns hostile.

npcs.reward: Ring of the Evil Eye, Quiet Resolve; Anri's Straight Sword (Aldrich route) or the Sword of Avowal and three Dark Sigils (Londor route)
steps: Meet Anri and Horace near the Halfway Fortress bonfire in [[Road of Sacrifices]]. Horace gives the [[Blue Sentinels]] emblem.
Use their summon signs for [[Deacons of the Deep]]. Once you have the [[Small Doll]], they appear at Firelink Shrine: talk to Anri.
After the [[Abyss Watchers]], find Anri in the [[Catacombs of Carthus]] near the rope bridge, then decide about Horace (in a cavern in [[Smouldering Lake]]).

In [[Irithyll of the Boreal Valley]], talk to Anri at the Church of Yorshka to learn Quiet Resolve. Anri gives the [[Ring of the Evil Eye]] here if you left the Catacombs without finding out about Horace.

Decide about the assassin hidden in the Church of Yorshka. Kill her: Anri goes on to fight [[Aldrich, Devourer of Gods]] and [[Yuria of Londor]]'s questline ends. Spare her: the Londor route, and Yuria's questline goes on.

Aldrich route, after [[Pontiff Sulyvahn]]: use Anri's summon sign in front of the doors of the grand cathedral of [[Anor Londo]] and help Anri defeat Aldrich. Then [[Ludleth of Courland]] gives you [[Anri's Straight Sword]].
Londor route, after [[Pontiff Sulyvahn]]: go to Gwyn's honorary tomb in [[Anor Londo]]. The Old Woman of Londor gives the [[Sword of Avowal]]; perform the wedding with Anri for three [[Dark Sigil]]s.
missable: If you leave Horace alive and tell Anri where he is, Anri goes to him and dies: the quest ends.
If you kill Horace first and then tell Anri, you get the [[Ring of the Evil Eye]] and the quest goes on.
On the Aldrich route Anri later turns up hollowed and hostile: near the Cathedral of the Deep bonfire, or at Horace's grave in [[Smouldering Lake]] if you told Anri where he was.

npcs.reward: Red Eye Orb, Applause; invade him for the Crescent Moon Sword, Silver Mask and Soul of Rosaria
steps: After you light the Tower on the Wall bonfire or defeat [[Vordt of the Boreal Valley]], Leonhard appears at Firelink Shrine and gives you five [[Cracked Red Eye Orb]]s.
After the [[Curse-rotted Greatwood]] or the Cliff Underside bonfire, talk to him by Lothric's throne while you hold a [[Pale Tongue]]: he gives the Lift Chamber Key.
Open the door under the Tower on the Wall bonfire in [[High Wall of Lothric]] and kill the Darkwraith at the bottom of the elevator for a full [[Red Eye Orb]].
Talk to him again for the Applause gesture; he asks you to join [[Rosaria's Fingers]].
Offer a [[Pale Tongue]] to [[Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth]] (not the rebirth or appearance services): Leonhard then greets you near the entrance to her chamber.

When you reach [[Profaned Capital]] past [[Irithyll Dungeon]] (the Rosaria page says: the first bonfire in [[Anor Londo]]), he murders Rosaria and flees to [[Anor Londo]]. Take the [[Black Eye Orb]] she leaves behind.

Use the [[Black Eye Orb]] in [[Anor Londo]], in the chamber that once held the illusion of Gwynevere, to invade Leonhard's world. He drops the [[Soul of Rosaria]], his Silver Mask and the [[Crescent Moon Sword]]; the Shrine Handmaid then sells the rest of his set.

Return the soul to revive her, or give it to [[Ludleth of Courland]] for the [[Bountiful Sunlight]] miracle. Her death has no consequences: you can still reallocate, change appearance and offer Pale Tongues to rank up in the covenant.
missable: Offering a Pale Tongue to Rosaria makes [[Sirris of the Sunless Realms]]'s questline fail: complete Sirris' questline first, then Leonhard's.

steps: Drop from the right side of the bridge near the guillotine in [[Undead Settlement]] onto the ledge below and follow the path (Cliff Underside bonfire) to his cage.
Agree to be his pupil; he moves to the shrine basement and sells pyromancies.
Get the [[Jailer's Key Ring]] via the swamp of [[Profaned Capital]] (upper levels of the Giant Slave's cell).
Open her cell on the lower level of [[Irithyll Dungeon]] and agree to rescue her; she moves under the stairs left of Andre.

npcs.reward: Duel for the dragon stones; summon at Oceiros
steps: Meet him on the stairs in front of the shrine bonfire.
If you own all three dragon stones and got [[Hawkwood's Swordgrass]] from Andre, he waits near the Abyss Watchers bonfire in [[Farron Keep]] for a duel.

npcs.npc: Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement
s: Giant Archer of the Undead Settlement
steps: Carry a [[Young White Branch]] when you meet him and he stays friendly.
Collect all the Young White Branches in the base game (Undead Settlement, Cathedral of the Deep and Farron Keep); he dies on his own and you can loot the [[Hawk Ring]].

npcs.reward: Lapp's ending in The Ringed City
steps: Talk to Lapp each time you find him in [[The Ringed City]].
Find the Purging Monument and tell him.
missable: Tell him about the Purging Monument before you fight [[Slave Knight Gael]], or he turns hollow and attacks you.

npcs.reward: Prostration and Patches squat gestures, Rusted Coin, Rusted Gold Coin, a shop at Firelink Shrine
steps: In the [[Cathedral of the Deep]], take the elevator up near the entrance to the [[Deacons of the Deep]] boss room and open the large double doors to the rooftop. Patches, wearing the Catarina Set, asks you to cross a bridge.
In the middle of the bridge he lowers it to have the Giant Slaves kill you. He then waits on the opposite side of the bridge, shortly before the room where [[Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth]] is met.
Talk to him there and choose "You know who I am": he gives the Prostration gesture and a [[Rusted Coin]], and becomes a merchant.
At Firelink Shrine, take the elevator in the tower (the one that needs the [[Tower Key]]) to the top of the belfry: Patches locks the gate behind you.
Get out by dropping down onto the coffins that stick out of the wall (Spook or the [[Silvercat Ring]] help) or by warping with a [[Homeward Bone]].

Find him on the upper level of the shrine near the Giant Tree. Refuse to forgive him for a [[Rusted Gold Coin]]; he then sells his wares there for the rest of the game. Reload the area and talk to him while he squats for the Patches squat gesture.
If you sent [[Greirat of the Undead Settlement]] to pillage and tell Patches, he leaves to save Greirat; both return after you beat an area boss.
missable: Take the elevator to the cathedral roof from the Cleansing Chapel first and the bridge trap does not happen: his first encounter is then the Firelink Shrine trap.
Telling Patches about Greirat makes him leave only if you have not bought the full Catarina Set from him.

npcs.reward: Dignified Bow, Morion Blade, Yuria as a summon for Soul of Cinder; the Usurpation of Fire ending
steps: Draw out true strength with [[Yoel of Londor]] until you have all five [[Dark Sigil]]s before you reach the [[Catacombs of Carthus]]. Next time you visit Yoel's place he is dead and Yuria stands close by.
Talk to her for the Dignified Bow gesture.
Once [[Orbeck of Vinheim]] has moved to Firelink Shrine she asks you to settle the matter of Orbeck; bring her Orbeck's Ashes for the [[Morion Blade]].
Once you reach the [[Catacombs of Carthus]] she says she is guiding [[Anri of Astora]] to Irithyll. Keep Anri alive until [[Pontiff Sulyvahn]] has been defeated.
Do not kill the Londor Pilgrim within the Church of Yorshka.
Find Anri in the old Darkmoon tomb in [[Anor Londo]] and marry Anri for 3 more Dark Sigils, a total of 8.

Yuria then swears fealty to the Lord of Hollows; she no longer turns aggressive if attacked, unless the Fire Keeper heals your Dark Sigils. She can be summoned for [[Soul of Cinder]]. Link the First Flame while you hold 8 Dark Sigils for the Usurpation of Fire ending.
missable: If Yoel dies before you have all five Dark Sigils, Yuria never appears.
Yuria disappears if Anri dies at any point before Pontiff Sulyvahn.
If you kill or anger Yuria, the Londor Pale Shade invades you in [[Farron Keep]] and [[Irithyll of the Boreal Valley]] instead.

npcs.reward: Sacred Chime of Filianore, Titanite Slab
steps: In [[The Ringed City]], climb the stairs above the Ringed City Streets swamp, patrolled by Harald Legion Knights, to a large door. Shira speaks to you from the other side.
Tell her the name of Lord Gwyn, then accept her request to put [[Darkeater Midir]] to rest: she gives the [[Sacred Chime of Filianore]].
Her summon sign is inside the small shrine from which Midir's arena can be accessed; summoning her or not makes no difference to her request.
Defeat Midir, then talk to Shira for a [[Titanite Slab]].
missable: Do Midir before you touch the slumbering Filianore: after that Shira leaves her old places, turns permanently hostile and ambushes you in a ruin in the ash desert near the Filianore's Rest bonfire.
If you kill her there she drops the Crucifix of the Mad King and any gift she had not yet given; her set lies on a corpse behind her old door.
